scope: Isolated worker/provider-adapter diagnostics only; no hosted or real-provider acceptance

tests_first.harness_failure_before_red: Initial task checkout hit the Windows long-path limit and was automatically removed by Git. A command-scoped core.longpaths=true checkout then completed cleanly. First test import lacked workspace-local AJV; task-owned node_modules directories and isolated @eps links plus existing installed dependency links corrected resolution. Neither failure was claimed as a behavioral RED.

red.name_pattern: specs failures retain|specs diagnostic sink|specs diagnostic projection|timeout retains valid|operator specs diagnostic sink

final_green.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="specs failures retain|specs diagnostic sink|specs diagnostic projection|hostile diagnostic metadata|timeout retains valid|timeout diagnostic metadata|operator specs diagnostic sink|provider errors are redacted|known provider failure|heartbeats serialize|unknown or stale heartbeat" tests/worker/specs-executor.test.ts tests/integrations/specs.test.ts tests/worker/runtime.test.ts

private_value_scan: not_run; delegated task forbids credential/private-environment reads
dependency_resolution: Task node_modules and @eps are real directories, not a whole-main-node_modules junction. The four @eps links target this isolated checkout. Package-local dependency links reuse existing installed external dependencies without installation or writes.
